import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load datasets
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_json("./input/train/train.json", orient="records")
test_df = pd.read_json("./input/test/test.json", orient="records")

# Prepare target
y = train_df["requester_received_pizza"].astype(int)

# Common feature columns across train and test
common_features = [
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
    "request_text_edit_aware",
    "request_title",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc",
]

X_train_raw = train_df[common_features].copy()
X_test_raw = test_df[common_features].copy()


def engineer_features(df):
    # Text-based statistics
    df["title_len"] = df["request_title"].fillna("").astype(str).str.len()
    df["title_word_count"] = (
        df["request_title"].fillna("").astype(str).str.count(r"\b\w+\b")
    )
    df["text_len"] = df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("").astype(str).str.len()
    df["text_word_count"] = (
        df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("").astype(str).str.count(r"\b\w+\b")
    )

    # Temporal features from UTC timestamp
    ts = pd.to_datetime(df["unix_timestamp_of_request_utc"], unit="s", errors="coerce")
    df["hour"] = ts.dt.hour.fillna(12)
    df["day_of_week"] = ts.dt.dayofweek.fillna(3)
    df["is_weekend"] = (df["day_of_week"] >= 5).astype(int)

    # Remove raw text and timestamp columns after feature extraction
    df.drop(
        columns=[
            "request_title",
            "request_text_edit_aware",
            "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc",
        ],
        inplace=True,
    )
    return df


X_train = engineer_features(X_train_raw)
X_test = engineer_features(X_test_raw)

# Ensure all features are numeric
for df in [X_train, X_test]:
    for col in df.columns:
        if df[col].dtype == "object":
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")

# Sanitize infinite values
for df in [X_train, X_test]:
    df.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0, inplace=True)

# Impute missing values with median computed on full training set
fill_na_values = X_train.median()
X_train = X_train.fillna(fill_na_values)
X_test = X_test.fillna(fill_na_values)

# Final feature list
feature_names = X_train.columns.tolist()
X_train = X_train[feature_names]
X_test = X_test[feature_names]

# Stratified train/validation split (hold-out estimate)
X_tr, X_va, y_tr, y_va = train_test_split(
    X_train, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# LightGBM Classifier
print("Training model...")
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    objective="binary",
    metric="auc",
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=63,
    max_depth=6,
    n_estimators=300,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    min_child_samples=30,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
)

model.fit(X_tr, y_tr, eval_set=[(X_va, y_va)])
pred_va = model.predict_proba(X_va)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_va, pred_va)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.5f}")

# Generate predictions on test set and save submission
print("Saving submission...")
pred_test = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"request_id": test_df["request_id"], "requester_received_pizza": pred_test}
)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully to ./submission/submission.csv")
